meta.name: high-end-visual-design
meta.description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页设计拥有高端品牌质感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让AI生成的设计摆脱廉价感、更像专业工作室出品。
copy.tagline_en: Make web designs feel premium and agency-crafted
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI-generated designs to look expensive and professional.

howto.what: Claude 会按高端设计工作室的标准生成网页界面代码：使用高级字体、双层嵌套边框卡片、超大留白和自定义曲线动画，同时禁用常见默认字体、图标、边框阴影、布局和动效；每次输出会刻意变换风格，并为手机端做适配。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计网页、生成界面或写前端代码（如 React、Tailwind、HTML）时，技能会启用，套用上述设计规范和禁用项检查。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 SaaS 首页的响应式布局，用玻璃拟态风格。
say.note: Claude 会选取一种质感与布局模板，并检查禁用项。

say.text: 做一个双层嵌套边框卡片和按钮内图标的产品区块。
say.note: 会按双边框 + 按钮内按钮结构输出。

say.text: 把导航改成悬浮胶囊，汉堡菜单点击变形为 X。
say.note: 会生成浮岛导航与交错展开动效。

howto.what_en: Claude generates web UI per high-end studio standards: premium fonts, double-bezel cards, macro whitespace, custom motion; no default fonts/icons/borders/layouts/motion; varies each output and includes mobile fallbacks.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user asks for webpage design, interface generation, or front-end code (React/Tailwind/HTML).

say_en.text: Design a responsive SaaS homepage in glassmorphism style.
say_en.note: Picks a vibe/layout archetype and checks bans.

say_en.text: Build a product section with double-bezel cards and button-in-button icons.
say_en.note: Gives nested shells and an inner icon circle.

say_en.text: Turn this nav into a floating pill and make the hamburger morph into X.
say_en.note: Expect fluid island nav with staggered reveal.
